name: Marlstein
beschreibung: The Hotel Marlstein is located in the municipality of Haiming in Tirol, in the Ötztal. The surroundings are characterized by meadows and mountain panoramas. The amenities include a wellness area and lounge areas. The style is alpine-modern and creates a calm atmosphere. The target group is mainly active holidaymakers who explore the region on foot or on skis. The restaurant offers regional cuisine with seasonal products from the surrounding area.
